subject: Air freight quote: FRA to LOS
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from Frankfurt Airport (FRA) to LOS (Lagos, NG)?

We’ll deliver the shipment to FRA ourselves, and it’ll be ready on 2026-11-27. It’s 8 pieces of machine parts, with a gross weight of 1075 kg and a total volume of 5.92 cbm.

Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer? Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
